implementation.publication: One ephemeral Driver memory observation; only normalized cash DTO plus actual source/closing planning frames; excludes payment extras/journal, world snapshot and history
implementation.invalidation: Query begin replaces old observation with a unique in-flight marker; finally clears unfinished marker on failure. Closing failure or Q/P mismatch publishes no value. Marker identity prevents an older query from overwriting a newer observation.
implementation.service_call: GameplayBridgeService._plan_war_mercenary_with_current_cash_v1, invoked at the existing ordinary war consumer call in _plan_turn_internal_without_readonly_retry_v1
implementation.service_gate: Existing paused map, active war, no event/interaction and quiet life/route advance; mandatory and concrete action paths retain their existing behavior
implementation.service_read: current_war_cash_observation_v1 only reads memory under existing Driver lock; passes cash_resources/cash_source_frame only when qualified, otherwise preserves original call signature
implementation.frame_semantics: Q=query source, P=closing published semantic cache copy, S=current planning frame. Accept only complete typed Q==P==S; never re-label Q as P, force publication, increment a revision locally, or accept revision+1.
implementation.stale_observation: P!=S, including Native revision rollback, clears the slot; a later return to old Q does not revive it
implementation.closing_reader: Only already-existing take_internal_semantic_snapshot local semantic cache copy; missing reader/lock or absent loan leaf leaves no handoff. No endpoint/core query/force-refresh fallback.
